name: com.nova.ai.navigation
description: Pathfinding for NPCs and enemies (Unity AI Navigation): bake where agents can walk with NavMesh Surface (slope, step height, agent radius and height, several floors), then give a Nav Mesh Agent a destination - it finds a path around walls and obstacles and walks it with acceleration, braking and turning. C#: NavMeshAgent.SetDestination, NavMesh.CalculatePath / SamplePosition. Built on Recast & Detour (zlib): polygon nav mesh baked from the static colliders in tiles on all CPU cores.
